judgements.justification: A got higher ICQ D4RL means than B in 7 of 8 differing rows, the authors told xuSQ the baselines were fine-tuned but told uost they were defaults, and only B was offered a retitle.
No novelty verdict is shown to rest on a wrong account of prior work; B's EMaQ link was unchecked and 5dG2 agreed the methods differ in detail.
A's AC stated grounds for the spotlight: 'strong theoretical insight', the empirical results and timeliness.
B's critics objected to baselines, mixed results and novelty within offline RL; Rr7B's single-agent framing point came from the paper's own field.
No reviewer in A rated well above accept; all four settled at 7 with narrow clarification reviews.
B's AC rejected because the promised edits 'warrant another round of reviews', while A took the same rebuttal material and clarity edits as camera-ready changes.
Both ACs drew on the visible reviews and discussion; no off-record assessment is in the notes.
Both committees judged the paper as a method contribution by the same standards.
B's two 5s rested on central points, the mixed single-agent results and copied baselines, not a peripheral detail.
